# pvecli pool add

Create one or more resource pools.

```text
pvecli pool add [POOLID] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `POOLID` | Pool ID(s) - single or comma/semicolon-separated (e.g., dev or dev,staging,prod). |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-c`, `--comment VALUE` | Pool description. |
